name: Bulgemaxxing

lead: Bulgemaxxing is a style meta in which men choose garments, such as light-coloured shorts, joggers or fitted underwear, so the outline of the groin is visible. Participants describe it as part of presentation and as a confidence-signalling choice.
No studies have measured whether it changes how attractive someone is perceived to be; claims come from forum anecdotes, and forum members disagree about its effect.

paras: Forum posts discuss garment fit and fabric colour, underwear style and a confident posture and walk. Some mention staying lean to improve the silhouette.
Visible bulges can attract unwanted attention, and public decency norms differ by setting. Forum members also disagree on whether the approach helps.

chain: Garment fit, colour and underwear choice
angle.text: Participants use clothing to change the silhouette they present. The benefits are described by forum users and have not been measured in research.

lead: Bulgemaxxing is a looksmaxxing term for clothing choices that make a man's groin outline more visible, and sometimes more prominent. It belongs to the style metas of the community.

Its roots in menswear are old: the 15th and 16th century codpiece was shaped and padded to emphasise the genitals, peaked in the 1540s and was fading by the 1590s.[1] On looksmax.org, threads describe modern versions, including a guide that lists tight-but-not-baggy trousers, posture and low body fat.[2]

paras: A looksmax.org guide recommends trousers that are loose enough for comfort but not baggy, a wide stride, a lean physique and an upright, confident posture, and also asserts that going without underwear is the key step.[2] Another poster in a discussion thread asked whether a visible bulge helps on dating apps, after noticing a stranger's attention on public transport.[3]
Responses are mixed: some members report women's attention after an accidental visible bulge, while others say the look appears awkward.[2][3]

lore.intro: Bulgemaxxing is discussed in a few looksmax.org threads as a low-effort style tweak.[3]

claims.claim: A visible bulge increases attention from women
